caseTitle.en: The ankle that rolled on court

title.en: TCM traumatology: a day of ankles

tagline.en: Rule out the fracture, then talk tuina

desc.zh: 用渥太華規則決定要不要照 X 光、讀片、分期；認出那個「以為只是扭傷」的人。
desc.en: Use the Ottawa rules to decide on an X-ray, read it, stage the injury, and recognise the patient who only thinks it's a sprain.

desc.zh: 冷敷、外敷、包紮固定、拐杖教學與後期的平衡訓練是你的；急性期不重推、不熱敷。
desc.en: Ice, poultices, strapping, crutch training and later balance work are yours; no heavy pressure and no heat in the acute phase.

about.zh: 以前是籃球校隊，自己的腳踝扭過很多次。名言：「腳踝扭傷最常見的併發症，叫『以為只是扭傷』。」
about.en: A former school basketball player who has rolled his own ankles more times than he can count. His line: the commonest complication of an ankle sprain is “thinking it's just a sprain”.

about.zh: 前橄欖球員，力氣大到能把病人整個抱上床。正因為力氣大，他對力道比誰都小心。
about.en: A former rugby player strong enough to lift a patient onto the couch in one go, which is exactly why he is more careful with pressure than anyone.

about.zh: 虛構教學個案。十七歲，球隊的控球後衛。昨晚練球落地踩到隊友的腳，右腳踝往內翻。週六是冠軍賽。
about.en: Fictional teaching case. Seventeen, the team's point guard. Landed on a teammate's foot at practice last night and rolled his right ankle inwards. The final is on Saturday.

about.zh: 虛構教學個案。四十八歲工程師，週末羽球愛好者。說殺球時「好像有人從後面踢了我腳跟一下」，回頭卻沒有人。
about.en: Fictional teaching case. A forty-eight-year-old engineer and weekend badminton player. Says that during a smash “someone kicked me in the back of the heel”, but nobody was behind him.

about.zh: 照片子又快又準，最常說的一句：「片子上傳了，你自己看比我說清楚。」
about.en: Fast and precise. Her usual line: “Images are uploaded; you'll see it better than I can say it.”

about.zh: 嗓門很大、很愛球員。他的兩個目標：拿冠軍，和讓志豪打到大學。
about.en: Loud, and loves his players. Two goals: win the final, and get Chih-Hao playing at university.

plain.zh: 腳掌往內翻、腳踝外側被拉傷，最常見的腳踝扭傷。受傷的多半是外側的韌帶。
plain.en: The foot rolls inwards and the outer ankle is overstretched: the commonest ankle sprain, usually injuring the outer ligaments.

plain.zh: 決定扭傷要不要照 X 光的規則：內外踝後緣或尖端壓痛、第五蹠骨基部或舟狀骨壓痛、或受傷當下與就診時都無法自己走幾步，就要照。
plain.en: Rules for deciding whether a sprained ankle needs an X-ray: tenderness at the back edge or tip of either ankle bone, at the base of the fifth metatarsal or at the navicular, or being unable to take a few steps both at the time and in clinic.

plain.zh: 腳掌外側中段突起的骨頭。內翻扭傷時韌帶或肌腱可能把它拉斷，叫撕裂性骨折。
plain.en: The bump halfway along the outer edge of the foot. In an inversion injury a tendon or ligament can pull a fragment off it: an avulsion fracture.

plain.zh: 中醫傷科把損傷分為初期、中期、後期：初期活血化瘀、消腫止痛；中期和營生新、接骨續筋；後期補益肝腎、強筋健骨。
plain.en: TCM traumatology divides injury into early, middle and late stages: early, move blood, resolve stasis, reduce swelling and pain; middle, harmonise and regenerate, knit bone and sinew; late, tonify liver and kidney, strengthen sinew and bone.

plain.zh: 中醫認為跌打損傷後脈絡受損、血溢脈外成瘀、氣行受阻，於是腫、痛、瘀青。
plain.en: TCM holds that injury breaks the vessels, blood escapes and pools as stasis, and the flow of qi is blocked: swelling, pain and bruising.

plain.zh: 把藥粉調成糊狀敷在患處，用紗布固定。皮膚有傷口、過敏、起疹就停用。
plain.en: Herbal powder mixed into a paste and spread on the injured area, held with gauze. Stop if the skin is broken, allergic or rashy.

plain.zh: 清代《外科正宗》的外用散劑，中醫用來清熱解毒、消腫止痛，常用於急性紅腫熱痛。只外用，不內服。
plain.en: An external powder from the Qing-dynasty Orthodox Manual of External Medicine, used in TCM to clear heat, reduce swelling and ease pain in acute red, hot, swollen injuries. Topical only, never swallowed.

plain.zh: 一息四至、從容和緩。中醫認為是有胃氣的平和之脈，代表全身大致安和。
plain.en: Four beats per breath, unhurried and even. In TCM reasoning a calm pulse with stomach qi, showing the body as a whole is at peace.

plain.zh: 外踝前下方的凹陷處，膽經的原穴。中醫認為是外踝扭傷的局部要穴；急性期只輕按、不重揉。
plain.en: The hollow in front of and below the outer ankle bone, source point of the gallbladder channel. In TCM reasoning the key local point for an outer ankle sprain; only light pressure in the acute phase.

plain.zh: 中醫「上病下取、左病右取」的思路：右腳踝外側的傷，取左手腕背外側對應的陽池，一邊刺激一邊讓病人輕輕活動腳踝。
plain.en: TCM's “treat below for above, left for right”: for an injury of the outer right ankle, use Yangchi on the back of the left wrist, stimulating it while the patient gently moves the ankle.

plain.zh: 腳跟後方的大肌腱斷掉。常像被人從後面踢一下、聽到啪一聲，之後踮不起腳、走路拖平。要當天轉骨科，不推拿。
plain.en: The big tendon at the back of the heel snaps. Often feels like a kick from behind with a pop; afterwards the person cannot rise on tiptoe and walks flat-footed. Same-day orthopaedic referral; no tuina.

plain.zh: 病人趴著、腳懸在床尾，捏小腿肚。正常腳掌會往下動；阿基里斯腱斷了，腳掌不動。又叫湯普森測試。
plain.en: The patient lies face down with the feet over the end of the couch and the calf is squeezed. Normally the foot points down; with a ruptured Achilles it stays still. Also called the Thompson test.

plain.zh: 練腳踝「知道自己在哪裡」的能力：單腳站、閉眼站、站在軟墊上。扭傷後不練，容易一扭再扭。
plain.en: Training the ankle's sense of where it is: one-leg standing, eyes closed, on a wobble cushion. Skip it after a sprain and the ankle rolls again and again.

plain.zh: 疼痛、害怕、看到血或久站時，心跳變慢、血壓下降而昏倒。躺下、腳抬高通常很快恢復，要檢查有沒有跌傷。
plain.en: Pain, fear, the sight of blood or long standing slows the heart and drops the pressure until the person faints. Lying down with the legs raised usually brings quick recovery; check for injury from the fall.

text.zh: 冰袋、薄毛巾、彈性繃帶、外敷藥粉與調藥碗。冰袋一定隔著毛巾，不直接貼皮膚。
text.en: Ice packs, thin towels, elastic bandages, poultice powder and a mixing bowl. Ice always goes on through a towel, never straight on the skin.

text.zh: 拐杖頂端離腋下約兩三指，用手掌撐、不用腋下撐。護踝在中後期回場時用，不是讓人提早上場的藉口。
text.en: Crutch tops two or three fingers below the armpit, weight through the hands, never the armpits. The brace is for the return-to-play phase, not an excuse to play early.

text.zh: 志豪把它夾在手機殼裡。背面寫著球衣號碼，和教練用奇異筆寫的「大學見」。
text.en: Chih-Hao keeps it in his phone case. On the back: his shirt number, and the coach's marker-pen “see you at university”.

name.zh: 先排除骨折：渥太華規則
name.en: Rule out the fracture: Ottawa rules

text.zh: 扭傷不一定要照 X 光，但符合任何一項就要：外踝或內踝後緣、尖端有骨頭壓痛；第五蹠骨基部或舟狀骨壓痛；受傷當下和就診時都無法自己走幾步。另外，腳變形、皮膚蒼白發冷、麻木、劇痛不成比例，要想到骨折脫位或血管神經受傷，當天轉骨科或急診。中醫傷科講「摸法」，手摸心會，摸的第一件事就是骨頭，不是筋。
text.en: Not every sprain needs an X-ray, but any one of these does: bony tenderness at the back edge or tip of either ankle bone; tenderness at the base of the fifth metatarsal or the navicular; inability to take a few steps both at the time and in clinic. A deformed foot, pale cold skin, numbness or pain out of proportion suggests a fracture-dislocation or nerve and vessel injury: orthopaedics or emergency the same day. TCM traumatology prizes palpation, the hand feeling what the mind knows, and the first thing it feels for is bone, not sinew.

name.zh: 傷科三期與推拿的時機
name.en: The three stages and when tuina fits

text.zh: 初期（受傷後最初幾天）：中醫認為氣滯血瘀、腫痛明顯，治以活血化瘀、消腫止痛；做法是保護、抬高、冷敷、加壓包紮、外敷消腫藥，不在腫處重推重揉、不熱敷，以免出血更多。中期：腫消痛減，和營生新、續筋，開始輕柔理筋手法與活動度練習。後期：補益肝腎、強筋健骨，加強肌力、本體感覺與運動專項訓練，戴護踝漸進回場。分期看的是組織狀態，不只是天數。
text.en: Early (the first few days): TCM sees qi stagnation and blood stasis with marked swelling and pain; the method is to move blood, resolve stasis, reduce swelling and pain: protect, elevate, ice, compress, apply a cooling poultice, and no heavy pressure or heat on the swelling, which would bleed more. Middle: swelling and pain recede; harmonise and regenerate, mend the sinew, begin gentle sinew-regulating techniques and range-of-motion work. Late: tonify liver and kidney, strengthen sinew and bone, build strength, proprioception and sport-specific drills, and return to play gradually in a brace. The stage follows the tissue, not just the calendar.

name.zh: 以為只是扭傷：要轉診的腳踝

text.zh: 阿基里斯腱斷裂：被踢一下的感覺、啪一聲、踮不起腳、小腿捏擠測試腳掌不動，當天骨科。骨折：符合渥太華規則、X 光有骨折線。高位扭傷（脛腓聯合）：小腿下段前方痛、外旋時劇痛，復原慢，要骨科評估。另外：腳背麻、腳趾冷白（血管神經），紅腫熱痛加發燒（感染），老人輕微扭到就不能走（骨鬆骨折），都不是推拿室能自己處理的。
text.en: Achilles rupture: a kick-like feeling, a pop, no tiptoe, no foot movement on the calf squeeze test: orthopaedics today. Fracture: Ottawa-positive with a fracture line on X-ray. High ankle sprain (the syndesmosis): pain at the front of the lower shin and severe pain on turning the foot outwards; slow to heal, needs orthopaedic review. Also: a numb top of the foot or cold pale toes (nerves and vessels), redness, heat and fever (infection), or an older person who cannot walk after a minor twist (osteoporotic fracture). None of these is for a tuina room alone.

lines.zh: 白板上畫著一隻大腳，旁邊用紅筆圈了四個點。大熊在旁邊把冰袋一包包排進冰箱。
lines.en: A giant foot is drawn on the board, four spots circled in red. Big Bear is stacking ice packs into the freezer.

lines.zh: 傷科三期，你說。
lines.en: The three stages of injury. Go.

lines.zh: 初期活血化瘀、消腫止痛；中期和營生新、接骨續筋；後期補益肝腎、強筋健骨。
lines.en: Early: move blood, resolve stasis, reduce swelling and pain. Middle: harmonise and regenerate, mend bone and sinew. Late: tonify liver and kidney, strengthen sinew and bone.

lines.zh: 很好。但在「初期」之前還有一步：先排除骨折。白板上圈的四個點，就是渥太華腳踝規則要摸的骨頭。
lines.en: Good. But before “early” there's a step: rule out the fracture. The four circled spots are the bones the Ottawa ankle rules tell you to feel.

guide.en: Ask Big Bear about today's patients

lines.zh: 九點一個高中生，昨晚練球扭到，教練已經打過兩通電話了。十一點半一位打羽球的大哥，說也是扭到腳。
lines.en: Nine o'clock, a high-schooler who rolled his ankle at practice last night; his coach has rung twice already. Half eleven, a badminton guy who says he twisted his ankle too.

lines.zh: 兩個「扭到」。記住我的名言：最常見的併發症，叫「以為只是扭傷」。
lines.en: Two “twists”. Remember my line: the commonest complication is thinking it's just a sprain.

note.zh: 志豪：照片、讀片、初期處理

lines.zh: 落地踩到隊友的腳，往內一翻。當下有走回場邊，但一拐一拐的。週六冠軍賽，我一定要上。
lines.en: Landed on a teammate's foot and it rolled in. I walked off, limping. The final's on Saturday; I have to play.

lines.zh: 這是內翻扭傷。我摸幾個骨頭，痛就說。外踝後緣……還好？那腳掌外側中間這裡呢？
lines.en: That's an inversion sprain. I'll feel a few bones; tell me if it hurts. Back of the outer ankle bone… OK? And here, halfway along the outside of the foot?

lines.zh: 啊！那裡痛。
lines.en: Ow! That hurts.

lines.zh: 第五蹠骨基部壓痛。渥太華腳踝規則，符合一項。怎麼做？
lines.en: Tender at the base of the fifth metatarsal. One Ottawa criterion met. So?

lines.zh: 照腳踝和足部 X 光，排除撕裂性骨折再處理。
lines.en: Ankle and foot X-rays, to rule out an avulsion fracture before anything else.

lines.zh: 腳踝和足部都照了，正面側面加斜位。片子上傳了，你自己看比我說清楚。
lines.en: Ankle and foot done, front, side and oblique views. Images are uploaded; you'll see it better than I can say it.

question.zh: 第五蹠骨基部和內外踝，有沒有骨折線？關節對位如何？
question.en: Any fracture line at the base of the fifth metatarsal or either ankle bone? How is the joint alignment?

answer.zh: 本例未見骨折線，踝關節對位正常；外側軟組織腫脹。診斷外側韌帶扭傷，可以進入初期處理。
answer.en: In this case no fracture line is seen and the ankle is aligned; there is lateral soft-tissue swelling. Diagnosis: lateral ligament sprain, so early-stage care can begin.

post.zh: 骨頭沒事，現在才輪到筋。這就是「先排除骨折，再談推拿」。
post.en: The bone is clear; only now is it the sinew's turn. That is “rule out the fracture, then talk tuina”.

lines.zh: 傷在腳踝，脈也看一下。你覺得會摸到什麼？
lines.en: The injury is in the ankle, but check the pulse too. What do you expect?

q.zh: 一息四至，從容和緩、不浮不沉。這是？
q.en: Four beats per breath, unhurried, neither floating nor deep. Which pulse?

why.zh: 年輕人急性局部損傷，全身氣血尚和，脈多平和。中醫辨證要局部與整體並看：瘀在腳踝，不一定在脈上。
why.en: A young person with an acute local injury still has harmonious qi and blood overall, so the pulse is often calm. TCM looks at local and whole together: the stasis is in the ankle, not necessarily in the pulse.

why.zh: 澀脈往來艱澀，多見於久病血瘀。他昨天才受傷，瘀在局部。
why.en: A choppy pulse drags and is usually seen in long-standing stasis. He was injured yesterday; the stasis is local.

why.zh: 他沒有發燒、沒有全身熱象，脈率正常。若腫處紅熱加發燒，要想到感染。
why.en: No fever, no systemic heat, normal rate. A red, hot swelling with fever would make you think of infection.

post.zh: 緩脈。局部看瘀、整體看人。腳踝在初期，人很健康，這是好消息。
post.en: A moderate pulse. Look locally for stasis, look at the whole for the person. The ankle is in its early stage and the boy is healthy: good news.

lines.zh: 教練說，用力推一推把瘀血推散、再熱敷，週六纏緊一點就可以上。真的嗎？
lines.en: Coach says if you push hard to break up the bruise and then heat it, I can tape it tight and play Saturday. Is that true?

q.zh: 志豪想靠「推散瘀血加熱敷」趕上週六冠軍賽。
q.en: Chih-Hao hopes heavy massage and heat will get him to Saturday's final.

options.zh: 初期保護冷敷抬高，依進度漸進回場
options.en: Early stage: protect, ice, elevate; graded return

why.zh: 受傷最初幾天重推和熱敷會讓出血腫脹更嚴重。先控制腫脹，週六能不能上，看他能不能無痛跑跳、單腳跳，不看日期。
why.en: Heavy pressure and heat in the first days increase bleeding and swelling. Control the swelling first; whether he plays Saturday depends on pain-free running and hopping, not the date.

options.zh: 推散瘀血、熱敷，週六纏緊上場
options.en: Push out the bruise, heat it, tape and play

why.zh: 急性期重推熱敷會加重出血，韌帶沒長好就上場，很容易再扭、變成慢性不穩。
why.en: Heavy pressure and heat in the acute phase increase bleeding, and playing on an unhealed ligament invites another sprain and chronic instability.

options.zh: 打石膏，完全休息一個月
options.en: Cast it and rest completely for a month

why.zh: 一般韌帶扭傷不需要長時間完全固定。適當保護加早期漸進活動，恢復反而比較好。
why.en: An ordinary ligament sprain does not need long rigid immobilisation. Sensible protection with early graded movement heals better.

post.en: …OK. Do I still have a chance?

post.zh: 有。看你的腳踝怎麼回答，不是看日曆。
post.en: You do. Your ankle will answer, not the calendar.

lines.zh: 初期的處理，順序你排。我照你的順序拿東西。
lines.en: Early-stage care: you set the order, I'll fetch things in your sequence.

q.zh: 急性踝扭傷的初期處理
q.en: Early care of an acute ankle sprain

steps.zh: 依渥太華規則排除骨折
steps.en: Rule out fracture with the Ottawa rules

steps.zh: 彈性繃帶由遠而近加壓包紮
拐杖，可忍受下部分負重

post.zh: 包紮完看腳趾：粉紅、溫的、會動、不麻。不對就重包。
post.en: After strapping, check the toes: pink, warm, moving, not numb. If not, redo it.

lines.zh: 初期紅腫熱痛，外敷用清熱消腫的如意金黃散。只外用。挑出裡面的藥。
lines.en: Early, red, hot and swollen: we use the cooling Ruyi Jinhuang powder as a topical poultice. External only. Pick out its herbs.

q.zh: 選出如意金黃散裡的藥
q.en: Select the herbs in Ruyi Jinhuang powder

post.zh: 大黃、黃柏清熱，薑黃、白芷活血消腫止痛。附子、肉桂那一排是溫熱藥，跟熱敷一樣，初期不要。皮膚有傷口或起疹子就停。
post.en: Rhubarb and phellodendron clear heat; turmeric and angelica dahurica move blood and ease swelling. Aconite and cinnamon are warming, like heat itself: not in the early stage. Stop if the skin is broken or rashy.

lines.zh: 局部的丘墟、申脈、解溪，今天只輕按不重揉。再加左手腕的陽池，這叫對應取穴。圖上點給我看。
lines.en: Locally Qiuxu, Shenmai and Jiexi, light pressure only today. Then Yangchi on the left wrist: mirror-point selection. Show me.

q.zh: 點出丘墟、申脈、解溪、陽池
q.en: Tap Qiuxu, Shenmai, Jiexi and Yangchi

post.zh: 右腳外踝，對應左手腕背外側。中醫說「左病右取」。
post.en: Right outer ankle, left outer wrist. TCM says treat the right through the left.

guide.zh: 針刺左手陽池，讓他動腳踝
guide.en: Needle left Yangchi as he moves

lines.zh: 陽池在左手腕，依穴位標準深度進針，得氣後請他在不痛的範圍內慢慢轉動右腳踝。
lines.en: Yangchi on the left wrist, to the point's standard depth; once there is deqi, have him turn his right ankle slowly within pain-free range.

lines.zh: 志豪，手腕會有點痠脹。腳踝只轉到不痛的地方就停。
lines.en: Chih-Hao, your wrist will feel a bit achy and full. Turn your ankle only as far as it doesn't hurt.

post.zh: 咦，好像比剛剛好轉一點點。
post.en: Huh, it turns a tiny bit easier than before.

lines.zh: 拐杖頂端離腋下兩三指，用手掌撐。先出拐杖、再出受傷的腳、最後好腳。上樓好腳先、下樓拐杖先。
lines.en: Crutch tops two or three fingers below the armpit; weight through your palms. Crutches first, then the injured foot, then the good one. Upstairs good foot first; downstairs crutches first.

lines.zh: 口訣：好腳上天堂，壞腳下地獄。
lines.en: The rhyme: good foot up to heaven, bad foot down to… the floor below.

lines.zh: 志豪第一次撐著拐杖站起來，站了一會兒，臉色忽然發白，眼神飄掉，身體往旁邊歪。
lines.en: Chih-Hao stands on crutches for the first time. After a moment his face goes white, his eyes drift and he sways sideways.

lines.zh: 我……早上沒吃……耳朵嗡嗡的……
lines.en: I… didn't eat this morning… ears ringing…

options.zh: 扶他躺下、腳抬高、確認有無跌傷
options.en: Lay him down, legs up, check for injury

why.zh: 血管迷走神經性昏厥：疼痛、空腹、久站讓心跳變慢、血壓掉。平躺抬腿通常很快恢復，確認頭沒撞到、腳踝沒再扭到；不恢復就叫支援。
why.en: A vasovagal faint: pain, an empty stomach and standing slowed his heart and dropped his pressure. Lying flat with legs raised usually brings him round; check he didn't hit his head or re-twist the ankle; call for help if he doesn't recover.

options.zh: 讓他撐著拐杖站好、深呼吸
options.en: Keep him upright on the crutches; breathe deeply

why.zh: 站著昏倒會連人帶拐杖摔下去，腳踝和頭都危險。
why.en: Faint upright and he falls with his crutches; ankle and head both at risk.

options.en: Press Renzhong and slap his cheeks

why.zh: 先平躺、腳抬高讓血回到腦部。拍臉不會讓心跳變快。
why.en: Lie him flat with legs up so blood returns to the brain first. Slapping won't speed his heart.

post.zh: ……我剛剛是不是昏倒了？很丟臉。
一點也不。橄欖球隊的大塊頭看到針，倒得比你快。先喝點甜的。
post.en: Not at all. I've seen rugby giants go down faster at the sight of a needle. Have something sweet first.

note.zh: 張先生：阿基里斯腱斷裂

lines.zh: 殺球的時候，好像有人從後面踢了我腳跟一下，還聽到「啪」。回頭沒人。應該是扭到，推一推就好吧？
lines.en: During a smash it felt like someone kicked me in the back of the heel, and I heard a snap. Nobody there. Just a twist, right? A quick rub will do?

lines.zh: 張先生，您可以用右腳踮腳尖嗎？
lines.en: Mr Chang, can you rise on your right tiptoe?

lines.zh: 他試了兩次，腳跟抬不起來。走路的時候，右腳是平平拖著的。
lines.en: He tries twice; the heel won't lift. When he walks, his right foot drags along flat.

lines.zh: 被踢的感覺、啪一聲、踮不起腳。你想到什麼？做哪個測試？
lines.en: A kick, a snap, no tiptoe. What are you thinking? Which test?

lines.zh: 阿基里斯腱斷裂。做小腿捏擠測試：請他趴上治療床，腳懸在床尾。
lines.en: Achilles tendon rupture. The calf squeeze test: face down on the couch, feet over the end.

q.zh: 請張先生趴到治療床上
q.en: Get Mr Chang face down on the couch

post.zh: 你捏左小腿，左腳掌往下一點；捏右小腿，右腳掌一動也不動。
post.en: You squeeze the left calf and the left foot dips; you squeeze the right and the right foot does not move at all.

post.zh: 小腿捏擠測試陽性。這不是推拿室的病人。
post.en: Calf squeeze test positive. This is not a patient for the tuina room.

lines.zh: 張先生，這是阿基里斯腱斷裂，不能推。我們先把腳固定在腳尖微微朝下的位置，今天就轉骨科，可能要手術或特殊的支架。
lines.en: Mr Chang, this is an Achilles rupture; no massage. We'll splint your foot with the toes pointing slightly down and refer you to orthopaedics today; it may mean surgery or a special boot.

lines.zh: ……原來我被自己的腳筋踢了一腳。
lines.en: …So I was kicked by my own tendon.

lines.zh: 撐拐杖，不要踩那隻腳。以為只是扭傷，今天第二個。
lines.en: Crutches, no weight on that foot. Thinking it's just a sprain: the second one today.

sub.zh: 王教練：志豪週六到底能不能上？
sub.en: Coach Wang: can Chih-Hao play Saturday or not?

lines.zh: 醫師！志豪說你們不讓他推、不讓他熱敷。週六冠軍賽耶！
lines.en: Doctor! Chih-Hao says you won't massage it or heat it. It's the final on Saturday!

lines.zh: 骨頭沒斷，是韌帶扭傷。前幾天推和熱敷會讓它更腫。週五來複診，能無痛慢跑、單腳跳、急停，就戴護踝上場；不行就不上。
lines.en: No fracture; it's a ligament sprain. Massage and heat in these first days make it swell more. Bring him back Friday: if he can jog, hop on one leg and cut without pain, he plays in a brace; if not, he doesn't.

lines.zh: ……好。我比較想他打到大學。週五我陪他來。
lines.en: …Fine. I'd rather he's still playing at university. I'll bring him Friday.

sub.en: Coach Wang: the ankle is more swollen

lines.zh: 醫師，早上你說的那樣……志豪中午自己熱敷、又請學長幫他推，現在腫得像麵龜。
lines.en: Doctor, about what was said this morning… Chih-Hao heated it at lunch and had a senior rub it hard, and now it's swollen like a bun.

lines.zh: 是我早上說錯了。初期不熱敷、不重推。請他現在冷敷、抬高、包紮，明天回來給我看。
lines.en: That was my mistake this morning. No heat and no heavy rubbing early on. Ice, elevate and strap it now, and bring him back tomorrow.

lines.zh: 錯了就馬上打電話改，這也是傷科的一部分。
lines.en: When you're wrong, ring and fix it at once. That is part of traumatology too.

note.zh: 冷熱的選擇與三期計畫
note.en: Choosing cold or heat; the staged plan

lines.zh: 病人最常問：冰敷還是熱敷？這一段你讀熟，以後每天會被問十次。
lines.en: The question patients ask most: ice or heat? Learn this section well; you'll be asked ten times a day.

post.zh: 初期紅腫熱痛用冷；腫消了、進入中後期，筋僵、怕冷才考慮溫熱。看組織，不只看天數。
post.en: Early, red, hot and swollen: cold. Once the swelling is gone and the sinew is stiff and cold in the middle and late stages, consider warmth. Watch the tissue, not just the days.

lines.zh: 初期：保護、抬高、冷敷、外敷、加壓、拐杖。中期：輕柔理筋、活動度。後期：肌力、本體感覺訓練、戴護踝漸進回場。
lines.en: Early: protect, elevate, ice, poultice, compress, crutches. Middle: gentle sinew work and range. Late: strength, proprioceptive training, a graded return in a brace.

lines.zh: 後期那一項最常被跳過。不練平衡，腳踝就會一扭再扭。
lines.en: The late stage is the one people skip. Without balance training, an ankle rolls again and again.

lines.zh: 今天兩個「扭到」。一個是真的扭傷，一個是腳筋斷了。你靠什麼分的？
lines.en: Two “twists” today. One a true sprain, one a snapped tendon. What told them apart?

lines.zh: 志豪是內翻、外側腫、骨頭壓痛照了片沒骨折。張先生是被踢的感覺、啪一聲、踮不起腳、捏小腿腳不動。
lines.en: Chih-Hao: inversion, lateral swelling, bony tenderness, X-ray clear. Mr Chang: a kick, a snap, no tiptoe, no foot movement on the calf squeeze.

lines.zh: 手先摸骨，再摸筋，最後才推。今天你的手順序對了。
lines.en: The hand feels bone first, then sinew, and only then massages. Today your hands kept the right order.

sub.zh: 腳抬在三個枕頭上，明天可以熱敷嗎？
sub.en: Foot up on three pillows; can he heat it tomorrow?

lines.zh: 訊息：「腳抬在三個枕頭上，腳趾粉紅色會動。明天可以熱敷了嗎？我有吃晚餐。」
lines.en: Message: “Foot's up on three pillows, toes pink and wiggling. Can I use heat tomorrow? I ate dinner.”

lines.zh: 回他：明天還是冷敷、抬高。腳趾變白、變麻、痛到睡不著，就去急診。週五見，帶球員證。
lines.en: Reply: still ice and elevation tomorrow. If your toes go white or numb, or the pain keeps you awake, go to emergency. See you Friday; bring your player pass.

lines.zh: 他回了一個籃球的貼圖，和一個「好」。
lines.en: He sends back a basketball sticker and an “OK”.

sub.zh: 一個扭傷，一條斷掉的腳筋
sub.en: One sprain, and one snapped tendon
